Lin H.: heads-up — vendor upgrade invoices from PartnerOne missing term_months attribute in feed. Feed: partnerone_upgrades_20260531.json. Several lines were mapped as one-time instead of amortizable, so our system accelerated recognition.
Marcus P.: do we know how many invoices and $$ impact?
Lin H.: 5 invoices, total overstated recognized revenue = 47,900 USD. Mostly hosted subscription upgrades that should be amortized over 12 months.
BillingBot: [automated] import_alert: partnerone_upgrades_20260531.json 1 rows processed; 5 lines flagged with missing 'term_months' attribute.
Dana L.: materiality check: 47.9k < 50k threshold. Policy allows a manual deferral entry and note in month-end exceptions. Provide spreadsheet + ticket + ops logs.
Marcus P.: eng root cause: vendor changed schema to omit term_months when term=12 (assumed default). our parser treats missing as one-time. hotfix patched to default to 12 if absent. will re-run import.
Sasha I.: For accounting packet: spreadsheet with invoice ids/customer ids/line amounts, proposed JE text, and import dry-run logs. Also need a memo explaining the assumption change.
Lin H.: Proposed JE (USD):
DR Revenue (4001)    47,900
CR Deferred Revenue (2100)    47,900
Memo: "Manual deferral for PartnerOne upgrade invoices where term_months missing from feed (partnerone_upgrades_20260531.json). Reverse when corrected import posts or amortize per contract."
Dana L.: approve posting per policy. Please include vendor communication confirming schema change or corrected feed. Post as of 2026-05-31 close and reverse when corrected import applied.
Marcus P.: i'll run the re-import in dry-run and attach logs + checksum to ticket. ETA 4 hrs.
BillingBot: [automated] ticket_created: FIN-P1-301234 (title: PartnerOne feed missing term_months 47.9k manual deferral)
Lin H.: i'll build the spreadsheet and cc Dana + Sasha. timeline: spreadsheet by EOD PT, JE to post tomorrow AM after sign-off, re-import and verification within 24 hrs.
Dana L.: adding to month-end exceptions pack. thanks team :white_check_mark:
